rows.grounds: relative-compound indicating the form previously specified
past passive participle referring to what was stated earlier
demonstrative pronoun referring to that described form
demonstrative pronoun referring to the described form or its outcome

items.question: What response is required when the previously described fire-form appears?
premises: A particular form has already been described in the preceding context.
This described form may appear as a condition.
The appearance of that form calls for awaiting its outcome.
items.inference: When the described form appears, one must await the corresponding result.
uncertainties: Whether pratīkṣaṇam implies passive waiting or active observation is not fully explicit.
The exact referent of tasya, the form or its result, is contextually ambiguous.
items.plain_english: And if this form, which has been described, appears, then one should await its outcome.
